inputs.hint: The fact is that something does not exist. Describe only how the work is done today without it, as observed events or numbers. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: I watched the handoff between the risk assessment review and the acceptance criteria definition. When the risk assessment document is marked complete, nothing happens on the criteria side. There is no automatic signal or notification sent to the team owning the criteria. I observed three recent project cycles where this gap existed. In each case, the criteria remained static until a person manually opened the interface and typed in new requirements. No log entries appear in the integration layer for this transition. The process relies entirely on a human noticing the gap and acting. I saw the risk assessment status change to complete, but the acceptance criteria timestamp did not update automatically. The two work streams operate in isolation regarding this specific link.
output.reclassify_reason: The text is a purely observational report describing the lack of automatic integration and the reliance on manual intervention, without expressing any wishes, refusals, or trade-offs.
